ops.body: Owner root: next bounded controller repair in perf-write-unchanged-baseline-nov16. Current 1.0.1660 controller and helpers remain CPU-heavy. Native profile showed marshal loads and cyclic collection. Existing write decodes and retains all pre-change fields; patch reconstructs one at a time, shares unchanged values only after equality, and disables cyclic scans during materialization. It adds no second serialization pass. Regression cases cover unchanged identity, independent changed records, additions/deletions, and GC restoration on success/error. Next: ship targeted CI, merge, release, official local install, unquarantine, exact source verification and passive affected controller measurement. Overall task remains open. All 25 decisions and held criteria retained.
